verdict.rationale: The CRA's own EFILE channel lets enrolled electronic filers transmit many clients' returns system-to-system from certified software and view their transmission history. That is a sanctioned high-volume submission path, but the evidence never describes batch or bulk operations as such. Registering several program accounts on one BRO form is an adjacent convenience, not a bulk operation across many items. Missing for 10: explicit documented batch/bulk submission or bulk-action capability, programmatic bulk API access for users, scope limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
